paragraphs: In the morning, conduct PCR and cloning at a clean bench and wait for results. In the afternoon, count cells under a microscope, inspect staining, and enter data into the system. Field days involve observing wildlife, collecting samples, and recording environmental and behavioral information. Before finishing, revise papers, respond to reviewers, schedule the next day's experiments, and coordinate graduate students.

The greatest career risks are long research cycles and funding volatility. Results take time and grants are difficult to secure, while AI absorbs some image counting and sequence analysis.
